scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
target_beneficiary: Small and Marginal Farmers across India
benefit_details: Provides income support of Rs 6,000 per year in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 directly transferred to farmers bank accounts (Direct Benefit Transfer - DBT).
eligibility_criteria: Landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares in official land records. Excludes high-income taxpayers and institutional landholders.
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in portal, via PM-KISAN mobile app, or through nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar card and land record documents.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Landholding Ownership Certificate (Khasra/Khatauni), Bank Account Passbook linked with Aadhaar.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
target_beneficiary: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including sharecroppers and tenant farmers
benefit_details: Comprehensive crop insurance cover against yield losses caused by natural non-preventable risks such as drought, flood, dry spells, pest attacks, and landslides.
eligibility_criteria: Maximum premium paid by farmer is 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for Annual Commercial/Horticultural crops. Remaining premium is subsidized by State and Central Governments.
how_to_apply: Enroll through PMFBY portal (pmfby.gov.in), bank branches, insurance company agents, or CSC centers before crop cutoff dates.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Land Sowing Certificate, Land Ownership/Tenancy Agreement.

scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
target_beneficiary: Farmers, Tenant Farmers, Sharecroppers, Self Help Groups (SHGs), Animal Husbandry and Fisheries Farmers
benefit_details: Provides timely short-term credit loans for agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizers, pesticides), post-harvest expenses, and farm maintenance at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (with 3% prompt repayment incentive).
eligibility_criteria: All individual or joint borrower farmers cultivating land or engaged in animal husbandry and fisheries.
how_to_apply: Submit KCC application form at any commercial bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Cooperative Bank branch.
documents_required: Identity Proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Address Proof, Land Revenue Records, Passport photo.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) & Per Drop More Crop
target_beneficiary: Farmers seeking micro-irrigation systems (Drip and Sprinkler Irrigation)
benefit_details: Financial assistance and subsidies ranging from 45% to 55% for installing Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems to improve water use efficiency.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers owning land with an available water source (tube well, pond, or canal connection).
how_to_apply: Apply through the State Agriculture/Horticulture Department portal or local District Agriculture Office.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Ownership Papers, Bank Passbook, Soil and Water Test Report.

scheme_name: Soil Health Card (SHC) Scheme
target_beneficiary: All landholding farmers across Indian states
benefit_details: Provides a customized Soil Health Card containing status of 12 soil nutrients (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC) and specific crop-wise fertilizer dosage recommendations.
eligibility_criteria: Issued free of cost every 3 years after soil sample collection and testing at government soil testing laboratories.
how_to_apply: Soil samples are collected by agriculture department officials from farmer fields, or farmers can submit samples at local Soil Testing Labs.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card and Land Survey Number (Khasra Number).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
target_beneficiary: Small and Marginal Farmers aged 18 to 40 years
benefit_details: A voluntary pension scheme providing a minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after reaching the age of 60 years.
eligibility_criteria: Small and marginal farmers holding up to 2 hectares of cultivable land, aged 18 to 40 years. Monthly contribution ranges from Rs 55 to Rs 200 based on entry age.
how_to_apply: Enroll at nearest CSC center or self-register on pmkmy.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card and Savings Bank Account Passbook linked with Aadhaar.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri KUSUM Yojana (PM-KUSUM Component A, B, C)
target_beneficiary: Individual Farmers, Panchayats, Cooperatives, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
benefit_details: Provides up to 60% subsidy for setting up standalone solar agriculture pumps (Component B) and solarizing existing grid-connected agriculture pumps (Component C), plus earning extra income by selling surplus solar power back to the DISCOM grid.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers having agricultural land with need for irrigation pumps.
how_to_apply: Apply online on State Renewable Energy Development Agency portal (e.g. UPNEDA, HAREDA, MAHADISCOM).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Ownership Records, Bank Passbook, Electricity Bill (for grid connected pumps).

scheme_name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM) Portal
target_beneficiary: Farmers, APMC Mandi Traders, Commission Agents, Farmer Producer Organizations
benefit_details: Pan-India electronic trading portal integrating agricultural APMC mandis to enable transparent online bidding, real-time market price discovery, and direct online payment into farmer bank accounts.
eligibility_criteria: Free online registration for any farmer selling agricultural produce at registered e-NAM mandis.
how_to_apply: Register online at enam.gov.in portal or via e-NAM mobile app with mandi gate registration.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Mobile Number.

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) & Custom Hiring Centres
target_beneficiary: Farmers, FPOs, Rural Youth, Custom Hiring Centre Entrepreneurs
benefit_details: Subsidies ranging from 40% to 80% for purchasing agricultural machinery (tractors, rotavators, combine harvesters, power tillers) and setting up Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs).
eligibility_criteria: Small, marginal, women, and SC/ST farmers get higher subsidy priority.
how_to_apply: Apply online at agrimachinery.nic.in portal or via FARMS mobile app.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Land Ownership Proof, Caste Certificate (if applicable).

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) & Organic Farming
target_beneficiary: Farmers forming clusters of 20 or more hectares for organic farming
benefit_details: Financial assistance of Rs 50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, organic seed procurement, vermicomposting, certification, and eco-friendly packaging.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming in clusters of 50 or more farmers covering 50 acres.
how_to_apply: Contact District Agriculture Officer or Regional Executive Agency under PKVY scheme.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Records, Cluster Group Registration Form.

scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
target_beneficiary: Rural adult households willing to do unskilled manual work
benefit_details: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per financial year to rural households, including farm asset creation, farm pond construction, bunding, and land development.
eligibility_criteria: Adult members of any rural household residing in Gram Panchayat area.
how_to_apply: Apply for Job Card at local Gram Panchayat office.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, Bank/Post Office Savings Account Passbook, Passport photo.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
target_beneficiary: Individual Micro Food Processing Units, SHGs, FPOs, Cooperatives
benefit_details: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost up to a maximum of Rs 10 Lakh for upgrading food processing units (milling, jaggery, spice grinding, pickles).
eligibility_criteria: Existing or new micro food processing enterprises with owner aged above 18 years.
how_to_apply: Apply online on pmfme.mofpi.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Business Project Report, Bank Passbook, GST/FSSAI (if applicable).

scheme_name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
target_beneficiary: Farmers, FPOs, PACS (Primary Agricultural Credit Societies), Agri-Entrepreneurs
benefit_details: Medium-to-long term debt financing for post-harvest infrastructure (cold stores, warehouses, sorting/grading units) with 3% interest subvention per annum up to Rs 2 Crore.
eligibility_criteria: Entities setting up eligible post-harvest agricultural management infrastructure.
how_to_apply: Submit loan application online at agriinfra.dac.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Entity Registration, Detailed Project Report (DPR), Land Lease/Ownership Document, Bank Account Details.

scheme_name: Rastriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY-RAFTAAR) & Agri-Startup Incubation
benefit_details: Grant-in-aid funding up to Rs 5 Lakh for pre-idea stage and up to Rs 25 Lakh for seed stage agri-enterprises and innovation startups.
eligibility_criteria: Startups working in agriculture, allied sectors, food processing, or farm technology.
how_to_apply: Apply through designated RKVY Agribusiness Incubators (RABIs) across India.
documents_required: Pitch Deck, Company Registration, Aadhaar Card, Financial Statements.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
target_beneficiary: Fish Farmers, Fishers, Fish Vendors, Fisheries Cooperatives
benefit_details: Financial assistance and 40% to 60% subsidy for fish pond construction, biofloc fish farming, cage culture, motor boats, cold chain vehicles, and fish hatcheries.
eligibility_criteria: Individual fishers, fish farmers, SC/ST/Women fishers get higher 60% subsidy.
how_to_apply: Submit proposal to District Fisheries Office or online via pmmsy.dof.gov.in portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land/Pond Document, Bank Passbook, Fisheries License.

scheme_name: National Agriculture Insurance Scheme (NAIS)
target_beneficiary: All farmers growing food crops, oilseeds, and selected commercial/horticultural crops in notified areas
benefit_details: Comprehensive crop insurance coverage against yield losses caused by natural calamities (drought, flood, hailstorm, cyclone), pests, and diseases. Subsidized premiums for small and marginal farmers. Claims directly transferred to farmer bank accounts.
eligibility_criteria: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas and seasons. Coverage for sowing/planting risk, standing crop losses, post-harvest losses, and localized risks like hailstorms and landslides.
how_to_apply: Report crop losses to local agriculture office or insurer within 48 hours of the incident. Assessment by joint team of local authorities and insurance company.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Ownership/Tenancy Document, Crop Sowing Certificate, Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSM)
target_beneficiary: Farmers growing rice, wheat, pulses, millets (Shree Anna), coarse cereals, sugarcane, jute across 28 States and 2 UTs
benefit_details: Financial assistance through States for demonstrations on improved crop production technologies, distribution of certified seeds of notified varieties, Integrated Nutrient Management (INM) and Integrated Pest Management (IPM) interventions, and cropping system-based training programmes.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers in districts identified by State governments having relatively low productivity but high production potential for target crops.
how_to_apply: Contact District Agriculture Officer or State Agriculture Department. Seed minikits distributed through central and state seed agencies.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Records, Bank Account Details.

scheme_name: National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF)
target_beneficiary: Farmers willing to adopt chemical-free natural farming practices across India
benefit_details: Financial assistance for on-farm input production infrastructure with total outlay of Rs 2,481 crore. Covers 7.5 lakh hectares, 15,000 clusters, 10,000 Bio-Input Resource Centres (BRCs). Provides continuous hand-holding, easy certification for chemical-free produce, and a National Logo for naturally grown products.
eligibility_criteria: Any farmer willing to adopt natural farming practices integrating livestock with diversified crop systems using local cow breeds.
how_to_apply: Contact local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), District Agriculture Officer, or State Agriculture Department for enrollment in natural farming clusters.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Records, Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: Coconut Palm Insurance Scheme (CPIS)
target_beneficiary: Coconut growers across all coconut-growing States in India
benefit_details: Insurance coverage for healthy nut-bearing coconut palms (age 4-60 years) against natural perils including storm, cyclone, flood, pest/disease, accidental fire, earthquake, landslide, tsunami, and severe drought leading to death or loss of palm.
eligibility_criteria: All healthy bearing coconut palms (Tall variety 7-60 years, Dwarf/Hybrid 4-60 years) grown as mono or intercropped. Unhealthy and senile palms excluded.
how_to_apply: Apply through Agriculture Insurance Company representatives or local Coconut Development Board (CDB) office in cluster villages.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Ownership Document, Palm Count Certificate, Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres Scheme (AC&ABC)
target_beneficiary: Agriculture graduates, graduates in allied subjects (Horticulture, Sericulture, Veterinary Sciences, Forestry, Dairy, Poultry, Fisheries) seeking to set up agri-enterprises
benefit_details: Start-up training for agriculture graduates to establish Agri-Clinics providing professional extension services to farmers. Special start-up loans available through NABARD for ventures after completing training.
eligibility_criteria: Fresh or experienced graduates in agriculture or any allied subject. Currently employed or unemployed candidates eligible.
how_to_apply: Apply online at acabcmis.gov.in portal. Training conducted by designated Nodal Training Institutes (NTIs) across India. Helpline: 9951851556.
documents_required: Graduation Certificate in Agriculture/Allied Subject, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Project Report.

scheme_name: SVAMITVA Yojana (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas)
target_beneficiary: Rural household owners in village inhabited (Abadi) areas across India
benefit_details: Provides Record of Rights and legal ownership cards (Property Cards/Title Deeds) to rural property owners by mapping land parcels using drone technology. Enables rural property to become bankable assets for loans. Over 1.46 lakh villages have received distributed cards.
eligibility_criteria: All rural households in Gram Panchayat areas where drone survey has been completed and maps verified by State Revenue Department.
how_to_apply: Property cards distributed through Gram Panchayat after drone survey completion and Gram Sabha verification. Check status at svamitva.nic.in.
documents_required: Existing property documents (if available), Aadhaar Card, Gram Panchayat residence proof.

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
target_beneficiary: Farmers, individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, dairy cooperative societies, FPOs, Panchayati Raj institutions involved in small ruminant, poultry, piggery, and fodder sectors
benefit_details: Subsidies and financial assistance for entrepreneurship development in sheep, goat, poultry, and piggery farming. Covers breed improvement, feed and fodder development, and innovation. Priority given to SC/ST/women/BPL/small and marginal farmers.
eligibility_criteria: Eligible beneficiaries include farmers, individual entrepreneurs, and organized sector groups. More than one family member can be assisted if units are at separate locations (minimum 500m apart).
how_to_apply: Apply online at nlm.udyamimitra.in portal. Applications processed through Commercial Banks, Cooperative Banks, and Regional Rural Banks eligible for NABARD refinance.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Land/Shed Document, Project Report, Caste Certificate (if applicable).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
target_beneficiary: Houseless rural households and households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses identified through SECC 2011 data
benefit_details: Financial assistance of Rs 1,20,000 per unit for plain areas and Rs 1,30,000 for hilly/difficult areas. Optional loan up to Rs 70,000 at 3% lower interest. Minimum house size 25 sq m with dedicated cooking area. Additional Rs 12,000 for toilet (via SBM-G), 95 days MGNREGA employment, and free LPG connection (via Ujjwala).
eligibility_criteria: Beneficiaries identified using Housing Deprivation Parameters from SECC 2011, verified by Gram Sabhas. Must be houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated house.
how_to_apply: Beneficiary list prepared by Gram Sabha from SECC data. Check status at pmayg.dord.gov.in. Payments made electronically to Aadhaar-linked bank/post office accounts.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, SECC Inclusion Certificate, Bank/Post Office Account Passbook linked with Aadhaar, Land Document (if available).

scheme_name: Dairy Entrepreneurship Development Scheme (DEDS)
target_beneficiary: Farmers, individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, dairy cooperative societies, producer companies seeking to establish dairy units
benefit_details: Back-ended capital subsidy of 25% of project cost (33.33% for SC/ST farmers) for establishing small dairy units (2-10 crossbred/indigenous cows), rearing heifer calves, purchasing milking machines/bulk milk cooling units, dairy processing equipment, cold storage, transportation, and veterinary clinics.
eligibility_criteria: All individual or group borrower farmers. Priority to SC/ST/women/landless/small and marginal/BPL farmers and drought area farmers. Minimum entrepreneur contribution of 10% for loans above Rs 1.6 lakh.
how_to_apply: Submit project proposal to any Commercial Bank, Cooperative Bank, or Regional Rural Bank eligible for NABARD refinance. NABARD is the Nodal Agency.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Detailed Project Report (DPR), Land/Shed Document, Caste Certificate (if applicable), Veterinary Health Certificate for animals.

scheme_name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM)
target_beneficiary: Small and marginal farmers, landless labourers owning indigenous bovine breeds (cattle and buffalo) across India
benefit_details: 100% grant-in-aid for genetic upgradation of bovine population through AI coverage, breed improvement using sex-sorted semen, IVF technology, and genomics. 50% assistance on cost of sex-sorted semen. 3% interest subvention on loans for high genetic merit (HGM) IVF-born heifers. 35% capital cost assistance for Heifer Rearing Centres. Total outlay Rs 3,400 crore.
eligibility_criteria: All farmers with indigenous bovine breeds. Over 70% of livestock farming work undertaken by women, so special focus on women farmers.
how_to_apply: Contact local veterinary/animal husbandry office or AI technician (MAITRI) for artificial insemination services. Apply through State Animal Husbandry Department.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Cattle/Buffalo ownership proof, Bank Passbook, Bharat Pashudhan app registration.

scheme_name: National Beekeeping and Honey Mission (NBHM)
target_beneficiary: Beekeepers, farmers, landless labourers, SHGs, FPOs, agri-entrepreneurs involved in apiculture across India
benefit_details: Financial assistance for scientific beekeeping with total budget outlay of Rs 500 crore. Covers bee colony distribution, honey testing labs, disease diagnostic labs, processing units, custom hiring centres, packaging and cold storage. Formation of 100 FPOs of beekeepers. India is now 2nd largest honey exporter globally.
eligibility_criteria: Any farmer, landless labourer, SHG, FPO, or entrepreneur willing to adopt scientific beekeeping as part of integrated farming system.
how_to_apply: Register on Madhukranti portal (madhukranti.in). Apply through National Bee Board (NBB) or State Agriculture/Horticulture Department.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Document (if applicable), Bank Passbook, SHG/FPO Registration (if applicable).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
target_beneficiary: Adult women (18+ years) from poor households without existing LPG connection
benefit_details: Deposit-free LPG connection with free pressure regulator, safety hose, first refill, and hot plate (stove). Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) subsidy of Rs 300 per 14.2 kg cylinder for eligible refills. Financial support of Rs 1,600 per connection.
eligibility_criteria: Applicant must be adult woman aged 18+. No other LPG connection in the same household. Must belong to poor household (SC/ST, PMAY, AAY beneficiaries, forest dwellers, or extreme poor per SECC data).
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest Indane/HP Gas/Bharat Gas distributor or online at pmuy.gov.in portal. Helpline: 14438 (Ujjwala) / 1906 (LPG Emergency).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card or address proof, Bank Account Passbook, Passport-size photograph, Deprivation Declaration.

scheme_name: Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) - Har Ghar Jal
target_beneficiary: All rural households across India seeking safe and adequate drinking water through individual tap connections
benefit_details: Provides functional household tap connections (FHTC) to all rural households. As of August 2026, 6.33 crore rural households (81.81%) connected out of 7.76 crore total. Includes source sustainability measures like rainwater harvesting, grey water management, and water conservation.
eligibility_criteria: All rural households in Gram Panchayat areas. Priority to quality-affected habitations, drought-prone areas, SC/ST majority villages, and aspirational districts.
how_to_apply: Contact local Gram Panchayat, Paani Samiti (Village Water & Sanitation Committee), or District Water & Sanitation Mission (DWSM). Track progress at ejalshakti.gov.in.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Gram Panchayat residence proof. No individual application needed in most states as connections provided village-wise.

scheme_name: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) - Universal School Education
target_beneficiary: Children from pre-school to Class 12 across India, especially children from farming and rural families
benefit_details: Free textbooks, uniforms, and mid-day meals (PM POSHAN) in government schools. Transport allowances for remote rural children. Sharda programme to re-enroll out-of-school children through bridge courses. Vocational training aligned with NEP 2020 including modern agricultural practices from Class 9-12. Smart classrooms and ICT labs in rural schools.
eligibility_criteria: All children aged 6-18 years enrolled in or eligible for government and government-aided schools. Special focus on SC/ST/minority/disabled/girl children from rural and farming households.
how_to_apply: Enrollment through nearest government school or Samagra Shiksha Kendra. Contact Block Education Officer or District Education Office.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of child and parent, Birth Certificate, Previous school Transfer Certificate (if applicable), Caste Certificate (if applicable).

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
target_beneficiary: Poor and vulnerable families across India identified through SECC 2011 data for cashless hospitalization
benefit_details: Cashless hospitalization coverage of Rs 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare services at empanelled hospitals. Covers pre and post hospitalization expenses, diagnostics, medicines, and treatment. No cap on family size or age. Portable across India.
eligibility_criteria: Families identified as deprived under SECC 2011 categories. Covers rural families with kutcha houses, no adult earning member, female-headed households, SC/ST households, landless manual labourers, and destitute/living on alms.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at mera.pmjay.gov.in or call Ayushman Bharat helpline 14555. Get Ayushman Card at nearest empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre (CSC).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, SECC inclusion letter, any government-issued ID. Ayushman Card issued free of cost.

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana (DDUGJY)
benefit_details: Provides continuous power supply to rural India by separating agriculture and non-agriculture feeders, and strengthening the sub-transmission and distribution network.
eligibility_criteria: All rural households, specifically focusing on un-electrified villages and BPL (Below Poverty Line) households.
how_to_apply: Implemented by State DISCOMs. BPL households can apply for free electricity connections through their local Gram Panchayat or electricity department.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, BPL Ration Card (for free connection), Residence Proof.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
target_beneficiary: Poor and vulnerable citizens covered under National Food Security Act (NFSA)
benefit_details: Provides 5 kg of free food grains (rice or wheat) per person per month, in addition to the regular subsidized food grains under NFSA.
eligibility_criteria: Families holding Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) ration cards.
how_to_apply: No separate application needed. Beneficiaries can collect their free ration from the nearest Fair Price Shop (FPS) using their existing ration card.
documents_required: Valid Ration Card (AAY or PHH), Aadhaar linked to the ration card for biometric authentication (ePoS).

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
target_beneficiary: Unbanked citizens, especially in rural areas
benefit_details: Provides access to a basic savings bank account with no minimum balance requirement, a RuPay debit card, and an inbuilt accident insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh. Also allows overdraft facility up to Rs 10,000.
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen above 10 years of age who does not already have a bank account.
how_to_apply: Open an account at any bank branch or Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra) outlet.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or any official valid document (OVD) like PAN card or MGNREGA job card.

scheme_name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
benefit_details: Provides a guaranteed minimum monthly pension ranging from Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 after the age of 60 years, depending on the contributions made.
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen between 18 and 40 years of age with a savings bank account/post office savings bank account.
how_to_apply: Apply through the bank branch or post office where the individual holds a savings account, or via net banking.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details, Mobile Number.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
target_beneficiary: Poor and low-income section of the society
benefit_details: Provides life insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh in case of death due to any reason for an annual premium of Rs 436.
eligibility_criteria: People in the age group of 18 to 50 years having a bank account who give their consent to join/enable auto-debit.
how_to_apply: Enroll via participating banks or post offices, or through internet banking (auto-debit).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account, Consent form for auto-debit.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
benefit_details: Provides accidental death and full disability cover of Rs 2 lakh and Rs 1 lakh for partial disability for an annual premium of just Rs 20.
eligibility_criteria: People in the age group of 18 to 70 years with a bank/post office account who give their consent to join/enable auto-debit.
how_to_apply: Enroll via participating banks/post offices or through net banking for auto-debit.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account, Consent form for auto-debit.

scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
target_beneficiary: Poor rural women and marginalized communities
benefit_details: Mobilizes rural poor women into Self Help Groups (SHGs) and provides them with capital support, training, and access to financial services to start livelihood activities.
eligibility_criteria: Women from rural poor households identified through Participatory Identification of Poor (PIP) and SECC data.
how_to_apply: Approach the local Gram Panchayat or the Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU) to form or join an SHG.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account (for SHG), Residence Proof, BPL/SECC identification.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
benefit_details: Provides collateral-free loans up to Rs 10 lakh to micro-enterprises under three categories: Shishu (up to Rs 50k), Kishore (Rs 50k - 5 lakh), and Tarun (Rs 5 lakh - 10 lakh).
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for a non-farm sector income generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading or service sector.
how_to_apply: Apply at commercial banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs, or online through the Udyamimitra portal.
documents_required: Identity Proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Proof of Address, Business Plan/Project Report, Bank Statement.

scheme_name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
benefit_details: A small deposit scheme offering a high interest rate and tax benefits under Section 80C to help parents build a fund for their girl childs education and marriage.
eligibility_criteria: Parents or legal guardians can open the account for a girl child below the age of 10 years. Maximum two accounts allowed per family (one for each girl child).
how_to_apply: Open an account at any post office or authorized commercial bank branch.
documents_required: Birth Certificate of the girl child, Identity and Address Proof of the parent/guardian (Aadhaar, PAN).

scheme_name: PM Vishwakarma
target_beneficiary: Traditional artisans and craftspeople (like carpenters, blacksmiths, potters, weavers, etc.)
benefit_details: Provides PM Vishwakarma Certificate/ID card, basic/advanced skill training with stipend, collateral-free credit support up to Rs 3 lakh, toolkit incentive of Rs 15,000, and digital/marketing support.
eligibility_criteria: Artisans/craftspeople working with hands and tools in one of the 18 specified traditional trades, aged 18 years or above.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the PM Vishwakarma portal using Aadhaar authentication, or visit the nearest CSC for assistance.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Mobile Number, Bank Account Details, Ration Card (for family identification).

scheme_name: PM Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM AASHA)
target_beneficiary: Farmers producing oilseeds, pulses, and copra
benefit_details: Ensures remunerative prices to farmers for their produce. Includes Price Support Scheme (PSS), Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS), and Pilot of Private Procurement & Stockist Scheme (PPPS).
eligibility_criteria: Farmers registered with state agencies for procurement of selected crops at Minimum Support Price (MSP).
how_to_apply: Register on the respective State procurement portal before the harvesting season.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Land Sowing Certificate (Girdawari).

scheme_name: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA)
target_beneficiary: Gram Panchayats and rural local bodies
benefit_details: Strengthens Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs) for achieving Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) with main thrust on convergence with Mission Antyodaya and emphasis on capacity building.
eligibility_criteria: All Gram Panchayats across the country.
how_to_apply: Funds are allocated to states based on their annual action plans. No individual application required.
documents_required: Panchayat resolution and utilization certificates for fund release.

scheme_name: Saubhagya Yojana (Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana)
target_beneficiary: Unelectrified households in rural and urban areas
benefit_details: Provides free electricity connections to all willing households in rural areas and poor families in urban areas. Includes Solar Photovoltaic (SPV) based standalone systems for un-electrified households located in remote and inaccessible villages.
eligibility_criteria: Beneficiaries identified using SECC 2011 data. Un-electrified households not covered under SECC can also avail the benefit on payment of Rs 500.
how_to_apply: Camps organized by DISCOMs in villages for on-the-spot registration.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Driving License.

scheme_name: Krishonnati Yojana
benefit_details: Umbrella scheme comprising 11 missions including MIDH, NFSM, NMAET, NMSA, SMAE, etc. Focuses on developing agriculture infrastructure, increasing production, and better returns on produce.
eligibility_criteria: Varies by the specific sub-mission. Generally applicable to all farmers, with preference to small/marginal farmers.
how_to_apply: Apply through specific sub-scheme portals or local district agriculture offices.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Records, Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: Swachh Bharat Abhiyan (Gramin)
benefit_details: Provides financial incentive of Rs 12,000 for the construction of Individual Household Latrines (IHHL) to achieve Open Defecation Free (ODF) status and improve rural sanitation.
eligibility_criteria: BPL households and identified APL households (SC/ST, physically handicapped, landless laborers with homestead, small and marginal farmers, and women-headed households).
how_to_apply: Apply online at sbm.gov.in or through the Gram Panchayat.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Photograph of the site.

scheme_name: Deendayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
target_beneficiary: Rural Youth from poor families aged 15-35 years
benefit_details: Provides free skill training programs aligned with national standards, uniform, boarding & lodging, and guarantees placement for at least 75% of trained candidates.
eligibility_criteria: Rural youth aged 15-35 years (upper age limit is 45 years for SC/ST/Women/PWD). Must belong to BPL, Antyodaya, or MGNREGA worker families.
how_to_apply: Register through the Kaushal Panjee portal or contact the nearest Project Implementing Agency (PIA) or Gram Panchayat.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, BPL Card/MGNREGA Job Card, Educational Certificates, Passport size photos.

scheme_name: Sansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY)
benefit_details: Members of Parliament adopt a Gram Panchayat to develop it into a model village (Adarsh Gram) with improved infrastructure, human development, and economic opportunities.
eligibility_criteria: Gram Panchayat must be adopted by an MP. Population should be 3000-5000 in plains and 1000-3000 in hilly/tribal areas.
how_to_apply: Villages are selected by MPs. Villagers participate through Gram Sabhas.
documents_required: Not applicable for individuals. Implemented at the Panchayat level.

scheme_name: Gramin Bhandaran Yojana (Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure)
benefit_details: Provides capital investment subsidy (15% to 33.33%) for the construction/renovation of rural godowns to prevent distress sale of agricultural produce.
eligibility_criteria: Individuals, farmers, cooperatives, or companies planning to build scientific storage capacity in rural areas.
how_to_apply: Apply through commercial/cooperative banks for bank loan. NABARD/NCDC handles the subsidy release.
documents_required: Detailed Project Report (DPR), Land Ownership/Lease papers, Bank Loan approval.

scheme_name: Livestock Insurance Scheme
benefit_details: Provides insurance cover to cattle/livestock at maximum current market price. Subsidy of 50% on the premium is provided to beneficiaries.
eligibility_criteria: Indigenous, crossbred, and exotic cattle and buffaloes yielding milk. Maximum of 2 animals per beneficiary.
how_to_apply: Contact the local Veterinary Officer or Animal Husbandry Department.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Health certificate of the animal from a veterinary doctor.

scheme_name: Sampoorna Grameen Rozgar Yojana (SGRY)
target_beneficiary: Rural poor in need of wage employment
benefit_details: Provides additional wage employment and food security in rural areas alongside the creation of durable community, social, and economic assets. Wages are paid as a mix of food grains and cash.
eligibility_criteria: Poor rural individuals in need of wage employment. (Note: Largely subsumed by MGNREGA, but legacy structures exist).
how_to_apply: Through the Gram Panchayat.
documents_required: Ration Card, Identity Proof.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
benefit_details: Provides all-weather road connectivity to eligible unconnected habitations as part of a poverty reduction strategy.
eligibility_criteria: Unconnected habitations with a population of 500+ in plain areas, and 250+ in special category states/desert/tribal areas.
how_to_apply: Implemented by State Rural Roads Development Agencies (SRRDA). Citizens can request roads through local representatives or the Meri Sadak app.
documents_required: No individual application required.

scheme_name: National Scheme on Welfare of Fishermen
benefit_details: Provides financial assistance for housing, community halls, drinking water tube-wells, and saving-cum-relief during lean/ban fishing periods.
eligibility_criteria: Full-time active fishermen who are members of a Cooperative Society/Federation/Welfare Society.
how_to_apply: Apply through the local Fisheries Cooperative Society or District Fisheries Office.
documents_required: Fisheries License/ID, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: Rythu Bandhu Scheme (Telangana)
benefit_details: Investment support of Rs 5,000 per acre per season (twice a year) for Kharif and Rabi seasons to support farm inputs like seeds, fertilizers, and pesticides.
eligibility_criteria: Must be a resident farmer of Telangana owning cultivable land. Tenant farmers are excluded.
how_to_apply: Apply through the local Village Revenue Officer (VRO) or Mandal Revenue Officer (MRO).
documents_required: Pattadar Passbook, Aadhaar Card, Bank Account Details.

scheme_name: YSR Rythu Bharosa (Andhra Pradesh)
target_beneficiary: Farmers and tenant farmers in Andhra Pradesh
benefit_details: Financial assistance of Rs 13,500 per farmer family per year, which includes Rs 6,000 from PM-KISAN.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers owning up to 5 acres of land. Landless tenant farmers belonging to SC/ST/BC/Minority categories are also eligible.
how_to_apply: Apply through Village Secretariats (Grama Sachivalayam).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Records, Bank Passbook, Tenant Cultivation Certificate (if applicable).

scheme_name: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation (KALIA) (Odisha)
target_beneficiary: Small/marginal farmers, landless agricultural laborers, and vulnerable agriculture households in Odisha
benefit_details: Financial support of Rs 25,000 per farm family over five seasons. Landless laborers get Rs 12,500 for allied activities (goat rearing, poultry). Vulnerable families get Rs 10,000 per year.
eligibility_criteria: Small/marginal farmers, landless agricultural laborers, and vulnerable households in Odisha.
how_to_apply: Apply through the KALIA web portal or at the Gram Panchayat level.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Domicile Certificate.

scheme_name: Bhavantar Bhugtan Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
target_beneficiary: Farmers producing notified crops in Madhya Pradesh
benefit_details: Compensates farmers for the difference between the official Minimum Support Price (MSP) and the actual selling price (modal rate) in the mandi.
eligibility_criteria: Must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh and sell produce in registered APMC mandis.
how_to_apply: Register on the MP E-Uparjan portal before the harvest season.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Records (Khasra), Bank Passbook, Samagra ID.

scheme_name: Jalyukt Shivar Abhiyan (Maharashtra)
target_beneficiary: Farmers in drought-prone villages of Maharashtra
benefit_details: Water conservation interventions including deepening of streams, construction of cement check dams, and farm ponds to make villages drought-free.
eligibility_criteria: Villages identified by the government as having severe water scarcity.
how_to_apply: Implemented at the village level by Gram Panchayats and the State Water Conservation Department.
documents_required: Not applicable for individuals. Community-level scheme.

scheme_name: Suryashakti Kisan Yojana (SKY) (Gujarat)
target_beneficiary: Farmers with existing electricity connections for agriculture in Gujarat
benefit_details: Farmers can generate their own solar power for irrigation and sell the surplus power back to the grid for additional income.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers who already have a grid-connected agricultural pump.
how_to_apply: Apply through the state DISCOM (PGVCL, DGVCL, etc.).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Records, Latest Electricity Bill.

scheme_name: Krishak Bandhu Scheme (West Bengal)
target_beneficiary: Farmers and sharecroppers in West Bengal
benefit_details: Assured income of up to Rs 10,000 per year for farmers with 1 acre or more. Death benefit of Rs 2 lakh to the family if a farmer (aged 18-60) dies.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers or registered sharecroppers with cultivable land in West Bengal.
how_to_apply: Apply at the local Duare Sarkar camp or Block Development Office (BDO).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, RoR (Record of Rights), Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Evam Sarvhitkari Bima Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
target_beneficiary: Farmers and poor individuals in Uttar Pradesh
benefit_details: Provides financial care and insurance of up to Rs 5 lakh in case of accidental death/disability and Rs 2.5 lakh for medical treatment.
eligibility_criteria: Age between 18 and 70 years, household income less than Rs 75,000 per year, and resident of UP.
how_to_apply: Through the District Magistrate's office or designated insurance company.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Age Proof.

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
target_beneficiary: Farmers producing paddy, maize, and sugarcane in Chhattisgarh
benefit_details: Input assistance of Rs 9,000 per acre to paddy farmers. Encourages crop diversification by providing Rs 10,000 per acre for planting pulses/oilseeds instead of paddy.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers registered with the state procurement portal.
how_to_apply: Register on the RGKNY portal or at local agricultural cooperative societies.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Land Records.

scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana (Jharkhand)
target_beneficiary: Small and marginal farmers in Jharkhand
benefit_details: Financial assistance of Rs 5,000 per acre, up to a maximum of 5 acres (Rs 25,000), provided via DBT.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers owning up to 5 acres of agricultural land.
how_to_apply: Apply at the Circle Office or through the state agriculture portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land Deed, Bank Account Details.

scheme_name: Kuruvai Cultivation Package (Tamil Nadu)
target_beneficiary: Farmers in the Cauvery delta region of Tamil Nadu
benefit_details: Subsidies on seeds, fertilizers, and farm machinery to boost paddy cultivation during the Kuruvai season.
eligibility_criteria: Paddy farmers in the designated Cauvery delta districts.
how_to_apply: Apply through the local Assistant Director of Agriculture.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Chitta/Adangal (Land Records), Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: Biju Krushak Kalyan Yojana (Odisha)
target_beneficiary: Farmers and their families in Odisha
benefit_details: Health insurance cover up to Rs 1 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary healthcare.
eligibility_criteria: Farmer families in Odisha.
how_to_apply: Distributed through Gram Panchayats and District Agriculture Offices.
documents_required: BKKY Smart Card, Aadhaar Card.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Krishi Rinn Yojana (Arunachal Pradesh)
benefit_details: Zero-interest crop loans up to Rs 3 lakh. The state government bears the 4% interest subvention usually borne by the farmer.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers who possess a valid Kisan Credit Card (KCC) and repay loans on time.
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank branch issuing KCCs in the state.
documents_required: Kisan Credit Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Kisan Kalyani Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
benefit_details: Provides an additional Rs 4,000 per year (in two installments) on top of the Rs 6,000 from PM-KISAN.
eligibility_criteria: Must be an existing beneficiary of the PM-KISAN scheme.
how_to_apply: No separate application needed if registered under PM-KISAN.
documents_required: PM-KISAN Registration ID, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: Gothan Nyay Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
target_beneficiary: Livestock owners and farmers in Chhattisgarh
benefit_details: State procures cow dung at Rs 2 per kg and cow urine at Rs 4 per liter to manufacture organic fertilizers.
eligibility_criteria: Livestock owners registered with local Gothans.
how_to_apply: Register at the village Gothan Samiti.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook.

scheme_name: "Immediate Relief Assistance" under "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme"
benefit_details: The scheme "Immediate Relief Assistance" is a Sub-Component under the scheme "Welfare and Relief for Fishermen During Lean Seasons and Natural Calamities Scheme". The scheme is extended to all the regions of the Union territory of Puducherry. The scheme is introduced with the objective of extending financial assistance to the fishermen's families to compensate for the loss due to the missing breadwinner and to support them financially to run their family. ₹ 1,00,000, in two installments of ₹ 50,000 each, as immediate relief assistance for the family (legal heir) of the missing fisherman. ﻿ Disbursal Initially, 50% will be extended within 3 months from the date of receipt of the application from the family (legal heir). The family (legal heir) should approach this department for the release of the balance 50% of the relief which will be deposited in the bank in a joint account in the name of kin (legal heir) and the competent authority concerned. If no further information is received about the missing person, the balance amount will be released in favour of the next of kin (legal heir), after the prescribed period of 9 months from the date of release of 1st part of lump sum. *In case of the return of the missing fishermen, the amount extended as compensation either ₹ 50,000 or ₹ 1,00,000 as the case may be, will be recovered by invoking an insurance bond.
eligibility_criteria: The applicant should be the family (legal heir) of the missing fisherman. The missing fisherman should have been a resident of the Union territory of Puducherry. The missing fisherman must have lost his/her life while fishing. The missing fisherman must have been in the age group of 18-60 years. The missing fisherman must not have been a beneficiary of the old age pension scheme. The missing fisherman should have enrolled as a member of the Fishermen/Fisherwomen Co-operative Society.
how_to_apply: Step 1: The interested applicant should visit the office of the concerned authority i.e. the Department of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare/Sub-Offices of outlying regions in all four regions. Step 1: The interested applicant should request the hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the concerned authority. Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the passport-sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the concerned authority. Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. Ensure that the receipt contains essential details such as the date and time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable). *The affected family (legal heir) should apply immediately within 30 days from the date of the event for consideration.
documents_required: Photograph of the Family (Legal Heir) of the Missing Fisherman. Residential Certificate of the Missing Fishermen. Proof of Age of the Missing Fishermen. Declaration That the Missing Fisherman Was Not a Beneficiary of the Old Age Pension Scheme. Membership Certificate from the President/Administrator of Fishermen/Fisherwoman Co-operative Society. Electoral Identity Card (Attested Copy) Ration Card (Attested Copy) Panchayathar’s Letter of Village Concerned Name, Relationship, and Address of the Legal Heir (Affidavit in ₹ 5 Stamp Paper, Affixing as the Legal Heir Duly Signed in Before a Notary Public). ‘No Claim’ Certificate in Respect of Financial Assistance Extended by the Revenue Department Should Be Obtained From the Department of Revenue and Disaster Management. FIR and Non-traceable Certificate From Respective Station House Officer of Police Department. Statement of Next Kin of Missing Person, Statement of Panchayathars, Statement of Persons Who Have Lastly Seen the Missing Person. Advertisement/newspaper Report of the Missing Person in Gazette in Tamil/local Newspaper, Municipality/ Commune Panchayat Office, Ration Shop, and Police Station in the Vernacular Language.

scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: State Capital Investment Subsidy
benefit_details: The scheme “State Capital Investment Subsidy” is a sub scheme under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector”. It was launched on 1st January, 2022, by the Department of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises and Textiles, Government of West Bengal, and shall remain valid upto 31st December, 2024. Objective of the "Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector”: The objective of the Scheme is to extend fiscal incentives for installation of New age shuttleless Powerlooms by MSMEs in Textile sector with a view to boost production of the improved quality fabrics and to create a sustainable ecosystem for MSMEs in Textile sector which can maximize the utilization of resource, generate new employment and widen the area of operation to make the State emerge as the leader in Powerloom sector in country. Objective of the "State Capital Investment Subsidy" Sub-scheme: Through this incentive, an eligible micro or small or medium enterprise in Powerloom sector irrespective of area/ zone will be entitled to Capital Investment Subsidy for its approved project of fixed capital investment on Plant and machinery (new age shuttle less powerloom). 20% of Fixed Capital Investment on Plant and machinery.
eligibility_criteria: The Scheme shall be generally applicable to all micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in the powerloom sector. Enterprises must have started production from 01.01.2022 to 31.12.2024. Enterprises should have executed a Four-party agreement with the Directorate of Textiles, Financial institution and Tantuja. The units should be a private sector, cooperative sector and joint sector undertaking as also companies/undertakings owned and managed by the State Government and the Industrial SHGs. The project should be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose. The project should have been approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution or Commercial Banks or State Financial Institutions.
how_to_apply: A micro, small or medium enterprise in Powerloom segment shall duly apply in prescribed form to the Directorate of Textile in Form-A1 before any investment in Plant and machinery (new age shuttle less loom). Time frame for submission of first Application: Within 12 months from the date of commencement of commercial production (01.01.2022 to 31.12.2024). Address: Directorate of Textiles, Handlooms, Spinning Mills, Silk Weaving & Handloom Based Handicrafts Division New Secretariat Buildings, 1, K. S. Roy Road, 5th Floor, 'B' Block, Kolkata 700001 Tel No. 033-2248 4537 / 2248 6271 (Ext. 215) Fax No. 033-2248 4537
documents_required: A copy of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association authenticated by the Registrar of Companies/ partnership deed (wherever applicable). A statement on the name and address of the Directors /Partners /Owners of the enterprise/ Members of Cooperative or Self Help Groups, as applicable. Copy of approved project report. A copy of loan sanctions letter and disbursement letter issued by financial institutions/ banks. Copy of agreement. A copy of the audited balance sheet for the last 2 years wherever applicable. Existing manufacturing activities in West Bengal stating items, annual approved capacity, annual production during the last three years (in quantity and value in Rs. Lakh), if applicable. Copy of the land deed (wherever applicable) (In case of rented /leasehold land / buildings, copy of rent agreement and receipt /lease agreement). Copy of mutation & conversion certificate of land/ building. Copy of valid consent to operate certificate from the WBPCB. Copies regarding SGST. Copy of Trade Licence. Copy of first electricity bill (wherever applicable). Copy of acknowledgement of Udyam Registration. Copy of SC /ST certificate wherever applicable. Copy of other statutory licenses/certificates, if necessary. “Self declaration” as per para 7.1(vi) of the Official Scheme Guidelines . Self certification on fixed assets as per Annexure-I .

scheme_name: Indira Mahila Shakti Udyam Protsahan Yojana
benefit_details: The Indira Mahila Shakti Udyam Protsahan Yojana (IMSUPY) is a scheme launched by the Rajasthan government to empower women entrepreneurs by providing them with financial assistance and support. The main objective of the scheme is to ecourage women to start their own businesses and become financially independent. Promote self-employment and reduce unemployment among women in Rajasthan. Support the growth of micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) led by women. Loan Limit Loan amount of ₹ 50,00,000/- to individual women. Loan amount of Rs 1,00,00,000/- to self-help groups. ﻿ Margin Money A margin money of 25% of the sanctioned loan amount will be provided under the scheme. For women belonging to Scheduled Castes/Tribes, Scheduled Castes, widows, abandoned women, victims of violence and disabled women, the margin money will be 30% of the sanctioned loan amount. Note : The maximum limit of margin money will be ₹ 15,00,000/-. The applicant's own contribution (5% / 10% of the project proposal) will be considered for margin money. Land value will not be included in the project proposal. The maximum limit of loan amount payable for construction of workshop/building will be up to 20% of the sanctioned amount of the project proposal. The maximum limit of loan for business will be Rs. 10 lakh. Business refers to wholesale or retail purchase-sale of commercial products. ﻿ Promotion of collateral security free loans: As per the guidelines of the Reserve Bank of India, collateral security will not be required for loans up to Rs. 10 lakh. Loans above Rs. 10 lakh can be linked with the Credit Guarantee Trust Fund for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE). The fee amount will be borne by the beneficiary. If the applicant voluntarily wants to give collateral security on the loan, they can do so. ﻿
eligibility_criteria: The applicant's age should be 18 years or more. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Rajasthan. The women's self-help group or group of these groups (cluster/ federation) must be registered under any department of the state government and in case of cluster/federation of groups, it will be necessary to be registered under the Cooperative Act as per the rules. ﻿
how_to_apply: Registration Step-1: Applicant have to visit the official portal . Step-2: Click on the option “ Register ”. Step-3: Then you will be redirected to the SSO registration page. The registration page will appear with the following options. Citizen Step-4: Choose the either one option from  the Jan Aadhaar Or Google to process further. Jan Aadhaar : Enter the Jan Aadhaar number, click on the ‘Next’ button, Select your name, the name of the head of the family and all the other members and Click on the ‘Send OTP’ button. Enter the ‘OTP’ and Click on the ‘Verify OTP’ button to Complete the registration. Google : Enter the Gmail ID, click on the ‘Next’ button, Enter the password. A new link appear on screen, now click on new SSO link. SSO id will appear on screen, now create the password. Enter Mobile number, click on registration. Step-5: Complete the registration process. ﻿ Apply Step-1: Applicant have to visit the official portal . Step-2: Read the instruction carefullly and click on " Apply ". Step-3: Click on an "Alert" button and page will redirected to SSO portal. Step-4: Now login with credentials. Step-5: Now click on "Apply for Scheme" on screen. Step-6: Now on the new page you will have to fill out the application form in 7 steps. - Such as a general description - Applicant details - Details of applicant and workplace - Description of the proposed project - Details of proposed financial institution - basis of ranking - Document Upload and Declaration Step-7: After filling in all the details in the application form, submit the application form. ﻿
documents_required: Aadhar card. Address proof. Bank account statement. Passport size photo. Mobile number.

scheme_name: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Capacity Utilisation
benefit_details: The scheme “State Capital Investment Subsidy” is a sub scheme under “The West Bengal Incentive Scheme”. It was launched on 22nd February, 2021, by the Department of Tourism, Government of West Bengal, and shall remain valid upto 31st December, 2025. Objective of the "West Bengal Incentive Scheme” Scheme: The object of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance and help enthusiastic intending or prospective entrepreneurs to start their own business as a self-employed youth who will become an employer in upcoming days and generate more employment. Objective of the “Capacity Utilisation” scheme: Through this incentive, an approved mega project of an eligible unit shall be entitled to additional Floor Area Ratio (FAR) over and above the maximum permissible FAR as may be fixed by the competent authority. Pattern of Assistance: 50%, subject to a maximum of ₹7,50,000/-.
eligibility_criteria: The Scheme shall be generally applicable to all eligible tourism projects/units and also to expansion projects of existing units set up on or after the effective date (i.e. 22nd February, 2021)  of this incentive scheme. Or, Eligible Hotel Units who started their commercial operation on or after 7th January, 2015 to 31st December, 2020 but could not apply under previous scheme 2015 due to absence of a Bar in the Hotel. The units may be in the private sector, co-operative sector, joint sector as also companies/undertakings owned or managed by the State Government. The project should be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose. The project should have been approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution or Commercial Banks or State Financial Institutions. The unit should hold an Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and Eligibility Certificate issued by the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited on satisfaction of arrangement.
how_to_apply: Registration Process: Step 1: Visit the official Shilpasathi portal and click on ‘Apply online’ button. Step 2: A sign up window will appear. Click on ‘Create New’ for new user. Step 3: Select the Industry /Business /Commercial /Charitable Society/ Govt. entity and enter the concerned Registration number. Step 4: Then the ‘User Registration’ window will appear with the relevant fields that the applicant needs to fill accurately and click on ‘Register’. In case the applicant already has an account, click on the ‘Sign In’ button and login using valid User ID, password and Captcha code. Application Process: Step 1: Visit the official Shilpasathi portal and click on ‘Apply online’ button. Step 2: Enter your user name, password and captcha code then click on “Log In”. Or sign in with the registered mobile number and OTP. Step 3: You will be directed to the user dashboard. Click on ‘ALL SERVICES’ to get the desired service. Step 4: A list of services will appear. Applicants need to click on the check box adjacent to the service named ‘Tourism Incentive’. Step 5: Once done, click on ‘Create CAF’. Applicant’s CAF ID will be created. Click on ‘Apply Online’ to proceed with the application. Step 6: You will be redirected to the common application form where he has to fill in the necessary details mentioned for proceeding further with the application. Step 7: Once done, attach the relevant documents required for the issuance of the certificate and click on ‘Save & Continue’. Step 8: Once uploaded, a ‘Document successfully uploaded’ header message will appear for confirmation. You will be shown the filled application with details provided for final review. Step 9: Once reviewed, the applicant needs to click on the ‘Declaration’ checkbox on the bottom left of the application page before proceeding to the ‘Submit’ button. Step 10: The applicant will receive notifications through SMS and email at critical stages of application processing–application submission, application approval or rejection at various stages. Step 11: Once done, the applicant will be auto redirected to the ‘Check status’ page to view the current status of the application. Step 12: Once all the steps are successfully completed , after Approval by the authority the applicant will receive in the online system the Registration certificate approved by the Department by clicking on the ‘Download Certificate’ button. Note: The steps for getting the incentives are Issue of Registration Certificate, Issue of Date of Commencement Certificate and issue of Eligibility Certificate before granting incentives in each case. After getting both the Registration and Date of Commercial Operation Certificate, the Tourism unit applies to the Managing Director, West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation for Eligibility Certificate. After getting all the above mentioned three certificates the eligible units apply to The Managing Director, West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation for Different types of incentives (see sl. 1) through different online forms. Helpdesk: Protiti, 23, Abanindranath Tagore Sarani (Camac Street), Kolkata - 700017, West Bengal, India. Phone: +91 33 2255 3700 Fax: +91 33 2255 3737 Email: silpa.sathi@wbidc.com For any technical query or any critical issues faced while submitting application please mail to our Quick Response Team at: qrt.silpasathiwb@gmail.com Silpa Sathi Single Window Cell - Helpline Number (Toll free): 1800-345-5562
documents_required: Documents required for the Registration and Eligibility Certificate (Form I) : A copy of the Memorandum and Articles of Association issued by the Registrar of Companies/ Partnership agreement. A Statement of names and addresses of the Director/ Partners/Owners of the company. Project Report. Valid No objection Certificate from pollution control Board. Valid No objection Certificate from West Bengal Fire Service. In case of loan, Photocopy of Sanction letter from the Central Financial Institution/State Financial institution/ Bank. Copy of the Audited Balance sheet for the last 3 years with Income Tax acknowledgement. Estimate for Building and Plant & Machinery vetted by Govt. Registered Valluer / Chattered Valluer. Land Deed and all other Documents supporting statements made in the Form (Mutation/ROR, Conversion Certificate, site plan,clearance from M.A. Deptt. etc. All applicable clearance from Govt. authorities (Forest, CRZ, Police, etc.) Sarai Registration Certificate under Bengal Sarai Regulation Act (in case Hotel started their Commercial operation) Valid Trade License from appropriate authority. GST Certificate and GST return. Sanctioned Building Plan from appropriate authority (KMC/ Municipality/ Panchayat/or any other appropriate authority). Documents required for the application of "Capacity Utilisation": Schedule of the lands. Sketch map of the land. Building purchased. Details of the proposed fixed capital investment to be made. Certificate to be issued by the Director of Tourism, Govt. of West Bengal, as per Annexure-A (format is available for download in attachment section).

scheme_name: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Interest Subsidy on Term Loan
benefit_details: “Interest Subsidy on Term Loan” is a sub scheme under “The West Bengal Incentive Scheme”. It was launched on 22nd February, 2021, by the Department of Tourism, Government of West Bengal, and shall remain valid upto 31st December, 2025. Objective of the "West Bengal Incentive Scheme” Scheme: The object of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance and help enthusiastic intending or prospective entrepreneurs to start their own business as a self-employed youth who will become an employer in upcoming days and generate more employment. Objectives of the "Interest Subsidy on Term Loan" Scheme: Through this incentive, an approved project of an eligible unit shall receive an Interest Subsidy on annual interest liability on the Term Loan borrowed from a Commercial Bank/Financial Institution. Group-'A’ and ‘B' areas: 50%, subject to a limit of ₹ 25,00,000/- per year, for 5 years. Group-'C' and 'D' areas: 60%, subject to a limit of ₹ 25,00,000/- per year, for 7 years. Special Areas: 75% , subject to a limit of ₹ 30,00,000/- per year, for 7 years. Note: The interest subsidy will be payable annually subject to submission of statement or certificate by the lending bank/financial institution to prove that the unit has paid the due interest to the institution on the due dates. The subsidy shall, however, not be paid in respect of term loans availed for second-hand plant and machinery or hire-purchase equipment. ﻿
eligibility_criteria: The Scheme shall be generally applicable to all eligible tourism projects/units and also to expansion projects of existing units set up on or after the effective date (i.e. 22nd February, 2021)  of this incentive scheme. Or, Eligible Hotel Units who started their commercial operation on or after 7th January, 2015 to 31st December, 2020 but could not apply under previous scheme 2015 due to absence of a Bar in the Hotel. The units may be in the private sector, co-operative sector, joint sector as also companies/ undertakings owned or managed by the State Government. The project should be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose. The project should have been approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution or Commercial Banks or State Financial Institutions. The unit should hold an Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and Eligibility Certificate issued by the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited on satisfaction of arrangement.
how_to_apply: Registration Process: Step 1: Visit the official Shilpasathi portal and click on ‘Apply online’ button. Step 2: A sign up window will appear. Click on ‘Create New’ for new user. Step 3: Select the Industry /Business /Commercial /Charitable Society/ Govt. entity and enter the concerned Registration number. Step 4: Then the ‘User Registration’ window will appear with the relevant fields that the applicant needs to fill accurately and click on ‘Register’. In case the applicant already has an account, click on the ‘Sign In’ button and login using valid User ID, password and Captcha code. Application Process: Step 1: Visit the official Shilpasathi portal and click on ‘Apply online’ button. Step 2: Enter your user name, password and captcha code then click on “Log In”. Or sign in with the registered mobile number and OTP. Step 3: Applicants will be directed to the user dashboard. Click on ‘ALL SERVICES’ to get the desired service. Step 4: A list of services will appear. Applicants need to click on the check box adjacent to the service named ‘Tourism Incentive’. Step 5: Once done, click on ‘Create CAF’. Applicant’s CAF ID will be created. Click on ‘Apply Online’ to proceed with the application. Step 6: Applicant will be redirected to the common application form where he has to fill in the necessary details mentioned for proceeding further with the application. Step 7: Once done, the applicant needs to attach the relevant documents required for the issuance of the certificate and click on ‘Save & Continue’. Step 8: Once uploaded, a ‘Document successfully uploaded’ header message will appear for confirmation. Applicants will be shown the filled application with details provided for final review. Step 9: Once reviewed, the applicant needs to click on the Declaration checkbox on the bottom left of the application page before proceeding to the ‘Submit’ button. Step 10: The applicant will receive notifications through SMS and email at critical stages of application processing–application submission, application approval or rejection at various stages. Step 11: Once done, the applicant will be auto redirected to the ‘Check status’ page to view the current status of the application. Step 12: Once all the steps are successfully completed , after Approval by the authority the applicant will receive in the online system the Registration certificate approved by the Department by clicking on the ‘Download Certificate’ button. Note: The steps for getting the incentives are Issue of Registration Certificate, Issue of Date of Commencement Certificate and issue of Eligibility Certificate before granting incentives in each case. After getting both the Registration and Date of Commercial Operation Certificate, the Tourism unit applies to the Managing Director, West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation for Eligibility Certificate. After getting all the above mentioned three certificates the eligible units apply to The Managing Director, West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation for Different types of incentives (see sl. 1) through different online forms. benefit_details: The scheme "Annual Insurance Premium for Boat Owners" is a Sub-Component under the Umbrella Scheme "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries" by the Department of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The scheme is introduced with the objective to increase marine fish production by extending subsidies for the procurement of annual premiums for insurance coverage paid by the registered mechanized boat operators. ﻿ ﻿ 50% subsidy subject to a maximum of ₹ 20,000 per boat on annual insurance premium. The rate of subsidy/maximum limit may be revised by the Government from time to time.
eligibility_criteria: The applicant should either belong to the fishermen community or be one of those professionally engaged in fishing/fish trade occupation on a full-time basis/prospective entrepreneurs. benefit_details: "Assistance for Energy and Water Conservation" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - Various Incentives" is a scheme by the Industries and Commerce Department, Union Territory of Puducherry. Through this scheme, 50% of the fees paid to the recognized institution/consultant for conducting the energy/water audit is reimbursed, subject to a limit of ₹25,000/-. In order to be eligible, the unit should have achieved saving in energy/water minimum by 10% of average monthly consumption of previous 12 months before conduct of audit. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available on the Official Website of the Department. Reimbursement of 50% of the fees paid to the recognized institution/consultant for conducting the energy/water audit, subject to a limit of ₹25,000/-. Number of Installments In single or multiple installments, depending on the availability of fund. Mode of Disbursement The subsidy amount shall be disbursed through the financial institutions/banks only, if the unit is financed by them, towards the adjustment against the loan availed by the entrepreneurs or for the creation of additional fixed assets or for the working capital purposes. In case of self-financed units, the subsidy shall be disbursed directly to the entrepreneur/unit. *The financial institution shall mean and include PIPDIC or any other Government Corporation, Scheduled Banks including Co-operative Banks.
eligibility_criteria: All the Micro, Small, Medium and Large Industries are eligible. The Unit should have made the investment on or after 1st April 2017. This 60% of the local employment will have to be maintained by the industrial unit during the period specified in the Affidavit. The unit should have achieved saving in energy/water minimum by 10% of average monthly consumption of previous 12 months before conduct of audit. The audit should have been conducted in the unit by a recognized institution/consultant. The industrial unit shall not transfer or dispose of the fixed asset including plant and machinery in any manner till the completion of 5 years from the date of submitting the application/disbursement of the subsidy whichever is later. scheme_name: "Capital Investment Subsidy (for New and Existing Industries)" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Capital Intensive Industries"
benefit_details: "Capital Investment Subsidy (for New and Existing Industries)" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Capital Intensive Industries" is a scheme by the Industries and Commerce Department, Union Territory of Puducherry. The scheme came into force with effect from 1st April 2017 and is in operation in the whole of the UT of Puducherry. Through this scheme, the enterprises and entrepreneurs are provided subsidy of upto 45% on the investments made on land, buildings, plant and machinery. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available on the Official Website of the Department. For Micro and Small Enterprises, a 40% subsidy on the investments made on land, building, plant and machinery, subject to a maximum of ₹40,00,000/-. For Medium and Large Enterprises, a 35% subsidy on the investments made on land, building, plant and machinery, subject to a maximum of ₹35,00,000/-. For Women/SC/ST Entrepreneurs, a 45% subsidy on the investments made on land, building, plant and machinery, subject to a maximum of ₹75,00,000/-. Number of Installments In single or multiple instalments, depending on the availability of funds. Mode of Disbursement The subsidy amount shall be disbursed through the financial institutions/banks only, if the unit is financed by them, towards the adjustment against the loan availed by the entrepreneurs or for the creation of additional fixed assets or for working capital purposes. In the case of self-financed units, the subsidy shall be disbursed directly to the entrepreneur/unit. *The financial institution shall mean and include PIPDIC or any other Government Corporation, Scheduled Banks including cooperative banks.
eligibility_criteria: The scheme applies to the Micro, Small, Medium and Large Enterprises, and to the Women/SC/ST Entrepreneurs. In the case of the SC/ST/Women category, the investments in respect of industrial units fully owned by the respective category and women entrepreneurs will alone be considered. In the case of partnership and private limited companies, all the partners, shareholders and Board of Directors shall belong to the respective category as the case may be. The Unit should have made the investment on or after 1st April 2017. The unit should provide at least 60% of employment to the people of the Union territory of Puducherry of the total employment strength of the industrial units. This 60% of the local employment will have to be maintained by the industrial unit during the period specified in the Affidavit. The industrial unit shall not transfer or dispose of the fixed asset including plant and machinery in any manner till the completion of 5 years from the date of submitting the application/disbursement of the subsidy whichever is later. The additional investments made by the new/existing industrial units after availing the first claim are also eligible for subsidy up to the ceiling limit. *The date of commencement, as admitted by the entrepreneurs, shall be reckoned after due verification by the officials of the Industries Department. *The units which have commenced commercial production on or after 1-4-2017 are considered new industries. *The units which have commenced production before 1-4-2017 are considered as existing units. Special Cases If, two or more industrial undertakings are set up by the same person as proprietor, common partners, common Board of Directors/shareholders, such units are eligible for subsidy as separate entity provided the location of the unit are different and licenses /clearances/ registrations are obtained separately for the enterprises.

Step 3: The unit should submit the duly filled and signed application form and the documents to the concerned authority. Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application form has been submitted. scheme_name: "Financial Grant for Reactivation of Mechanised Boats" under "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries"
benefit_details: The scheme "Financial Grant for Reactivation of Mechanised Boats" is a Sub-Component under the Umbrella Scheme "Financial Assistance for Availing Subsidy Components for the Development of Marine Fisheries" by the Department of Fisheries and Fishermen Welfare, Government of Puducherry. The scheme is introduced with the objective of increasing marine fish production by extending financial grants for the reactivation of wooden/steel mechanized boats. A financial grant for the reactivation of a registered wooden/steel mechanized boat will be extended at ₹ 10,000 per boat and ₹ 5,000 for a registered fiber-reinforced plastic mechanized boat. *The grant is subject to revision as and when approved by the Government from time to time.

The applicant must have been enrolled as a member of the Fishermen Co-operative Society and be above the age of 23 years and below 60 years. The applicant must not have been a recipient of Old Age Pension, issued by the department. The applicant should not be employed in Government/ Government Undertakings/Fishermen Co-operative Society. The applicant must not have any dues to be paid to the Department/Fishermen Co-operative Societies at the time of making the application. The applicant should possess a registered mechanized boat. The applicant should have carried out overhauling/ repairs to the engine/hull during the notified fishing ban period and should not have ventured fishing during the notified ban on fishing periods.
